title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust is the first benchmark that evaluates trustworthiness in real-world navigation, not just accuracy. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking is essential to measure progress — without it, we can't know if systems are truly reliable or just performing tricks. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust uses real-world datasets with human annotations and evaluates failure modes — that's actionable trust, not just theory. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking without transparency is just hype — NavTrust doesn't disclose how it handles edge cases or evaluates long-term reliability. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Trust is built on transparency — NavTrust can't show its full methodology, so it’s not a real benchmark. (4 sec)
